items.name: Polynomial.sum_modByMonic_coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} [Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} (hq : q.Monic) {n : ℕ} (hn : q.degree ≤ ↑n) : ∑ i, (Polynomial.monomial ↑i) ((p %ₘ q).coeff ↑i) = p %ₘ q

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_modByMonic_mem_pow_natDegree_mul
items.type: {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [CommRing R] [Ring S] [Algebra R S] (p q : Polynomial S) (Mp : Submodule R S) (hp : ∀ (i : ℕ), p.coeff i ∈ Mp) (hp' : 1 ∈ Mp) (Mq : Submodule R S) (hq : ∀ (i : ℕ), q.coeff i ∈ Mq) (hq' : 1 ∈ Mq) (i : ℕ) : (p %ₘ q).coeff i ∈ Mq ^ p.natDegree * Mp
